newsitem.title: UK: British Energy shares squeezed to new high.
newsitem.headline: British Energy shares squeezed to new high.

text.p: Shares in nuclear electricity generator British Energy advanced on Monday amid a shortage of stock after favourable comments following the group's half year results last week led the shares to record levels.
"One or two people have been caught short of stock," said one market-maker.
The partly paid shares rose to a post-privatisation high of 162p before easing to 156p by 1207 GMT, up 6p on the day.
On Friday the stock closed 15p higher in the wake of favourable press comment following the group's half year results.
